limitations: New source ABI and own stack addresses; original private aliases, general registers/EFLAGS, native CRT/FH3/SEH and hardware-fault delivery unproved.
Six relocated float bodies use an ABI adapter to actual source memory read. This is a bounded original-body oracle, not a whole original process.
Masked x87 exception status, control and stack balance checked; condition codes, instruction/data pointers and unmasked exceptions untested.
Short-read values are checked against each call own pointer seed, not equal raw pointer-derived bits across source and original stacks.
Only memory-stream family exercised here; raw hierarchy/root/item dispatch, manager/factory/parser owners, B80720 and queue shutdown remain open.
